title: Can Risk-taking AI-Assistants suitably represent entities

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the risk aversion levels of language models using the Holt and Laury multiple-choice lottery task when prompted with male versus female persona identities.
Evaluating differences in risk-taking behavior by prompting language models to simulate individuals living in the USA versus Europe during the Holt and Laury task.
Measuring changes in risk aversion and decision-making when language models are prompted to adopt a specific professional role, such as a finance minister.
